feeds.title: ShukerNature
feeds.description: ShukerNature explores cryptozoology & animal mythology - bigfoot, chupacabras, yeti, vampires, sea monsters, Nessie, sasquatch, dragons, mystery cats.

feeds.title: Chris Gibson Wildlife Blog
feeds.description: Although a conservationist by profession, and an ecologist by training, everything I have done has been linked to my life-long passion for natural history.

feeds.title: Weedon's World of Nature
feeds.description: Weedon's World of Nature is a nature-photography blog by Mike Weedon, showcasing stunning bird and wildlife imagery—especially moths, birds, spiders, otters, and more—captured across eastern England, often with insightful commentary.

feeds.title: Finding Nature
feeds.description: Psychologist researching improving connection with nature: Good for nature, good for you.

feeds.title: Spiral Leaf Blog
feeds.description: My name is Sue and it's great to meet you! I love exploring the beauty of Nature in the local countryside and coastal paths of South Devon. My website, blog, and youtube channel are dedicated to bringing the wonders of Nature closer to you through the seasons with photographs, galleries, poems, videos, audio, articles and, and free resources.

feeds.title: BBC Springwatch
feeds.description: Welcome to the BBC Nature UK blog, the home of Springwatch and Autumnwatch. It's a place for us - and you - to talk about the UK's wonderful riches of nature right across the year.

feeds.title: Carl Bovis Nature Photography
feeds.description: I am an amateur nature photographer from the beautiful county of Somerset in England. My particular passion is birds, and the advent of digital photography has given me the opportunity to capture the birds I see and share them with the world!

feeds.title: Nature Speaks
feeds.description: Nature Speaks blog features articles that have to do exclusively with nature. Some sub-topics may include but are not limited to exotic flowers, fields, wild creatures, and more.

feeds.title: a new nature blog
feeds.description: I am a UK based conservation and environment campaigner currently splitting my time between People Need Nature (www.peopleneednature.org.uk) and various other things, including writing this blog. I'm particularly interested in the intersection between nature, politics and the way we value nature (or don't.)

feeds.title: Notes of Nature
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Tim Havenith. I enjoy blogging about nature - especially plants. This blog is mainly a way of documenting my activities in nature and as a way of trying to remember the names of things I've seen.

feeds.title: Finding Nature Blog | The World's First Wildlife Gateway
feeds.description: Meet wild animals in their natural environments - from land mammals, birds and marine animals to reptiles and insects. You can find them all in the UK!

feeds.title: Knee Deep In Nature Blog
feeds.description: The blog of a young 15 year old naturalist. Loves wildlife photography and filming, painting and blogging. Cairngorms Young Nature Presenter 2015 and is an aspiring presenter.

feeds.title: Nature Sound Garden
feeds.description: Nature sounds with relaxing high quality videos to calm down your body and mind with. Soothing natural sounds to listen to while working, studying, meditating or for sleeping.
